mapper.select: SELECT b.NAME AS assetName, a.ASSET_ID AS assetId, a.FLAG, b.ASSET_MODE AS modeType, b.ORG_ID FROM ALARM_WHITE_LIST a LEFT JOIN ASSET b ON a.ASSET_ID = b.id WHERE a.id = #{whiteId}

SELECT b.NAME AS assetName, awa.ASSET_ID AS assetId, a.FLAG, b.ASSET_MODE AS modeType, b.ORG_ID FROM ALARM_WHITE_ASSET awa LEFT JOIN ASSET b ON awa.ASSET_ID = b.id LEFT JOIN ALARM_WHITE_LIST a ON awa.WHITE_ID = a.id WHERE a.id = #{whiteId}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ALARM_WHITE_LIST awa where #{flag} = '' OR #{alarmCode} LIKE concat('%', awa.ALARM_CODE) )
